-- ============================================================ -- 内容： -- 1. 新建 LINKAIAVT 表（激活记录表，与 LINKAIBAL 同库） -- 2. 初始化 LINKAIAVT 汇总行基线（MONQUOTA=0） -- 3. 初始化 LINKAIBAL 汇总行基线（MONQUOTA=0） -- -- 说明： -- - 两表汇总行基线由本脚本固化，永存不删，用于防删除/防清空检测 -- - 幂等：已存在基线时不重复插入 -- ============================================================
-- ------------------------------------------------------------ -- 1. 新建 LINKAIAVT 表 -- ------------------------------------------------------------ IF OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.LINKAIAVT', N'U') IS NULL BEGIN CREATE TABLE [dbo].[LINKAIAVT] ( [ID] [bigint] IDENTITY(1, 1) NOT NULL , [TOKENHASH] [varchar](64) NOT NULL -- 激活码 SHA256（唯一索引防重用） , [USR] [varchar](30) NOT NULL -- 用户标识 , [CUSTCODE] [varchar](30) NOT NULL -- 客户编码 , [MONQUOTA] [int] NOT NULL DEFAULT(0) -- 每月额度 , [MONTHS] [int] NOT NULL DEFAULT(0) -- 月数 , [STARTMONTH] [varchar](6) NOT NULL DEFAULT('') -- 起始月份 YYYYMM , [ACTIVATED] [datetime] NOT NULL DEFAULT(GETDATE()) , [ROWCHECK] [varchar](64) NULL DEFAULT('') -- HMAC-SHA256 行签名 , CONSTRAINT [PK_LINKAIAVT] PRIMARY KEY CLUSTERED ( [ID] ASC ) WITH ( PAD_INDEX = OFF , STATISTICS_NORECOMPUTE = OFF , IGNORE_DUP_KEY = OFF , ALLOW_ROW_LOCKS = ON , ALLOW_PAGE_LOCKS = ON ) ON [PRIMARY] ) ON [PRIMARY]
-- 唯一索引防激活码重用 CREATE UNIQUE NONCLUSTERED INDEX [IX_LINKAIAVT_TOKENHASH] ON [dbo].[LINKAIAVT] ([TOKENHASH]) WITH (PAD_INDEX = OFF, STATISTICS_NORECOMPUTE = OFF, IGNORE_DUP_KEY = OFF, ALLOW_ROW_LOCKS = ON, ALLOW_PAGE_LOCKS = ON) ON [PRIMARY] END
-- ------------------------------------------------------------ -- 2. 初始化 LINKAIAVT 汇总行基线（MONQUOTA=0） -- 签名字段: TOKENHASH|USR|CUSTCODE|MONQUOTA|MONTHS|STARTMONTH|ACTIVATED -- = __TOTAL__|__TOTAL__||0|0||2026-01-01 -- ------------------------------------------------------------ IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[LINKAIAVT] WHERE [TOKENHASH] = '__TOTAL__') BEGIN INSERT INTO [dbo].[LINKAIAVT] ([TOKENHASH], [USR], [CUSTCODE], [MONQUOTA], [MONTHS], [STARTMONTH], [ACTIVATED], [ROWCHECK]) VALUES ('__TOTAL__', '__TOTAL__', '', 0, 0, '', '2026-01-01', 'BFE984C451B5F2C44323220CAA61AA222B7FD546FAA0EBD20E6771184AB72D75') END
-- ------------------------------------------------------------ -- 3. 初始化 LINKAIBAL 汇总行基线（MONQUOTA=0） -- 签名字段: USR|MONTHKEY|MONQUOTA|USEDQUOTA|ISACTIVE|CRETIM -- = __TOTAL__||0|0|1|2026-01-01 -- ------------------------------------------------------------ IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM [dbo].[LINKAIBAL] WHERE [USR] = '__TOTAL__') BEGIN INSERT INTO [dbo].[LINKAIBAL] ([USR], [MONTHKEY], [MONQUOTA], [USEDQUOTA], [ISACTIVE], [ROWCHECK], [CRETIM], [UPDTIM]) VALUES ('__TOTAL__', '', 0, 0, 1, 'BBC1F0374A63666224756EEC8B5146DEE47B30493117783E030F544F9C20EADD', '2026-01-01', '2026-01-01') END
